name: Person Identification 10
definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify a person.

FirstName.name: First Name
FirstName.definition: First name of a person (also known as given name).

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

BirthDate.name: Birth Date
BirthDate.definition: Date on which a person is born.

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Unique identification of a person, as assigned by an institution, using an identification scheme.
